brief: Part of the Wayline Tower: read TOWER_DESIGN.md and the key (town.building.hall.key) first. Paint exactly this cell, lit from the upper left, from the wayline_tower palette only, with no outer outline (the game rims the tower). A route lantern: a small brass hand lantern hung by its ring, one under each of the seven sheaves. Lit flickers over 3 frames; dark is unlit glass while the route is idle; quiet is dusty grey glass with no wick for the route that went quiet (an absence, never a ghost).
notes: order 11; seven are hung at TowerParts.lantern_at(i), states from the story (Grok's set)
